title.narrative: World Bank: The Pandemic Fund (a financial intermediary fund, seed funding 2022)

description.narrative:
The Pandemic Fund builds on recommendations put forth by the G20 commissioned High Level Independent Panel on Financing the Global Commons for Pandemic Preparedness and Response and the WHO commissioned Independent Panel for Pandemic Preparedness and Response. These two panels recommended the establishment of a new fund that would finance capacities and fill gaps within pandemic preparedness and response (PPR) at global, regional and national levels. Countries being eligible for IDA, IDA Blend or IBRD qualify for support. The fund is set up as a financial intermediary fund (FIF) at the World Bank, with the secretariat also hosted by the World Bank but with strong technical support from WHO. While the fund will provide support to global and regional levels, the prime beneficiaries will be national governments and ultimately the population in those countries.
More specifically, the Pandemic Fund aims to: 1) Strengthen country-level pandemic PPR capacity 2) Build regionbal and global capacity 3) Support technical assistance, analytics, learning and convening
As a FIF, the fund must work through implementing entitites to support these levels. Multilateral development banks, including the World Bank, UN organisations and The Global Fund, Gavi and CEPI are accredited as possible implementing entities.
The Norwegian support at this stage amounts to NOK 50 million and intended to serve as seed funding for the establishment of the fund and its initial operationalisation.
